'''Alchemic Divergence'''  is a [[Utility spells|utility spell]] available in the [[standard spellbook]] in the [[Demonic Pacts League]] when the Tier 4 Relic [[Transmute (Demonic Pacts League)|Transmute]] was selected. It requires level 1 [[Magic]] to cast, and grants 10 Magic [[experience]] per item converted when cast.

This spell converts specific skilling resources into a higher tier of the same category effectively "upgrading" it. For example [[raw karambwan]]s can be upgraded to [[raw shark]]s after one cast, and upgraded again to [[raw anglerfish]]. When cast upon a stack of noted items, it will convert 10 of them at a time. These spells will automatically re-cast over time as long as the items are available in the same slot in your inventory.

This spell replaces the [[High Level Alchemy]] spell in your spellbook when unlocked, however, this can still be cast via a toggle or through the spellbook itself.
